summary: Explained unlimited loss risk on futures with real Jan 30 data. Key insight: unlimited does NOT mean gold goes to zero — it means a 3.7% move wipes exchange-minimum margin ($5,610) on 3 /MGC. Solution: Tier 1 Full Stop Coverage margin. Formula: (entry-stop) × oz × 1.20 gap buffer + maintenance. At $5,139 entry, $4,750 stop: $19,614 deposited for 3 /MGC instead of $5,610. Prevents forced liquidation, broker never intervenes before stop fires. Updated instrument-selection-guide.md with 3 margin tiers + dynamic recalculation rules. Memory #20 replaced.

summary:
FIXED: consultation rate limit was wall-clock "once per week per label" — arbitrary and wrong for a 24/7 system. Replaced with SIGNATURE-DRIVEN gating.

NEW GATE: re-consult Claude on a dormant component when ANY of these changes:
  - age bucket (log2 hours) grows — 24h→48h→96h are distinct signatures, captures "getting worse"
  - last stderr error class changes — different error = different problem
  - count of completed orch-queued tasks for this label increases — fix was tried, now evaluate it
  - 12+ hours elapsed since last consult regardless (catches context drift the signature missed)

HARD FLOOR: 1 hour minimum between consults for same label (prevents signature-noise thrash).

FUNCTION: _dormant_signature(dc, label, check_results) → "age6|err:Traceback: KeyError|tasks:2"
Stored in state as {label: {at, signature, confidence, fix_type}}. Compared each cycle.

WHY THE CHANGE MATTERS: if a LaunchAgent crashes at 25h dormant and fix_X is queued and completes, the signature shifts from "age4|err:noerr|tasks:0" to "age4|err:noerr|tasks:1" next cycle — orchestrator consults again with NEW information (task was attempted) instead of waiting 6 more days. Conversely, if nothing changed, consulting would produce the same answer so skipping saves Claude quota.
